bull_bear.body:
- 2024 milestone: "Secures INR 117 Cr via CCDs from global institutional investors HealthQuad and Tanas Capital for future growth"; HealthQuad partner Mr. Ajay Mahipal sits on the board as an Independent Director.
- Leverage rose sharply then eased: Debt to Equity of 0.07x (FY24), 0.70x (FY25) and 0.60x (FY26); non-current borrowings of INR 60 Mn (FY24), 1,270 Mn (FY25) and 1,333 Mn (FY26), with current borrowings of 50 / 111 / 145 Mn.
- ROCE is shown declining: 40.15% (FY24), 41.86% (FY25), 31.03% (FY26); working capital days rose 86 / 92 / 107 across FY24 / FY25 / FY26.
- Balance sheet carries cash and cash equivalents of INR 286 Mn (FY24), 1,470 Mn (FY25) and 1,248 Mn (FY26) against total equity of 1,571 / 1,971 / 2,447 Mn; property, plant and equipment grew 592 / 804 / 1,154 Mn with capital work in progress shown as nil in all three years.
- Shareholding as on 30 June 2026: Promoter 59.10%, Public 33.65%, DII 6.23%, FII 1.02%. The deck states no dividend, buyback or payout policy.
bull_bear.title: Capital allocation policy (investor deck)

business.body:
- "Beta Drugs Ltd. (BETA) is a specialty pharmaceutical company dedicated to improving cancer care through innovative therapies", offering "a comprehensive oncology portfolio under the 'Adley' brand, spanning chemotherapy, targeted and hormonal therapies" across tablets, capsules, injections and lyophilized injections.
- Claims "one of India's most comprehensive oncology platforms" covering breast, lung, brain, bone, prostate and hematological cancers, with products "available across 85%+ of corporate and government hospitals in India" and a "dedicated oncology-specialized field force and distribution network".
- "One of India's leading oncology-focused CMO partners, serving marquee pharmaceutical companies", with "95% Repeat Business from Key Customers" and "104+" clients.
- International reach is stated inconsistently across slides: "exports products across 25+ countries" (Company Overview) versus "Presence across 46+ countries, supported by 280+ dossier registrations" (Competitive Strengths); the 'At a Glance' panel separately carries a "26+" figure whose label binding is lost in extraction. Both readings are recorded rather than reconciled.
- Named molecules cited include Olaparib, Gefitinib, Erlotinib and Imatinib Mesylate; brands listed include Adcarb, Adplatin, Adcist, Kabonib, Adcumin, Kynolib, Adpaxil, Pazotab, AB-Pacli, Adbiron, Adgef, Adlante, Adtrinib, Adxate, Adthal, Adben.
business.title: Positioning (investor deck)

business.body:
- [Acquisition] "BETA entered the high-growth IVF segment through the acquisition of a 66.09% stake in Nivian Lifesciences Pvt. Ltd. in April 2026", with Nivian's IVF business consolidated from FY27 onwards; a footnote adds that "IVF revenues has been consolidated in the Domestic Branded Formulations from FY27 following Nivian Lifesciences becoming a subsidiary in April 2026", and a Non Controlling Interest line of (7) Mn appears in Q1-FY27 for the first time.
- [Acquisition] Nivian 'At a Glance' figures as printed: 31 No of Products, 15 States & UTs, 11 3rd Party Manufacturers, 1,209 Gynaecologists, 500 IUI Clinics, 61 Pan India Sales Team and "INR 299 Mn Contribution from Top 5 Brands"; two separate "1,500+" figures are labelled 'Fertility clinics' and 'IVF Labs', and the deck does not make clear which of these are Nivian's own reach versus market size.
- [Registrations] Dossier table (Approved Products / No of registrations till date* / Registration Pipeline): LATAM 52 / 90 / 220; APAC 63 / 105 / 105; MENA 17 / 26 / 157; AFRICA 29 / 59 / 53; CIS 5 / 0 / 88; Total 166 / 280 / 623 - the asterisk noting the registrations column "Excludes Approved Products".
- [Listing history] Listed on the NSE SME platform in 2017 and "Migrated from NSE SME to NSE Mainboard" in 2025; recognised in Forbes Asia "Best Under A Billion" for three consecutive years (2023, 2024 & 2025).
- [Governance] Founder-led group (Adley Group founded 1985 by Late Shri. Vijay Batra) with Mr. Rahul Batra as Chairman and Managing Director and Mr. Varun Batra as Joint Managing Director; the deck's own text says the company was "Established in 2005 as part of the Adley Group, by Mr. Vijay Kumar Batra".
business.title: Notable from the deck

deepdive.thesis: The deck positions Beta Drugs as an oncology-specialist Indian pharma company (established 2005, part of the Adley Group) running four business pillars - domestic branded formulations, CMO, exports and APIs - now diversifying into dermatology and IVF, with a stated "Vision 2030" to shift the revenue mix decisively toward its own branded products.

themes.title: Pharma CDMO / CRDMO & API import-substitution
themes.need: Global biopharma's China+1 sourcing plus a peptide/biologics modality boom drive India's CDMO/CRDMO build-out and API import-substitution. ANTHEM/COHANCE/NEULANDLAB/SYNGENE-tier on CRDMO (peptides/ADCs/oligos); DIVISLAB/LAURUSLABS on peptide CDMO; AKUMS/INNOVACAP/RUBICON on formulation CDMO; AARTIPHARM/SUPRIYA/AARTIDRUGS/SOLARA on APIs; SIGACHI/NATCAPSUQ/VIDHIING on excipients.
themes.driver: Customer regulatory filings unlocking dedicated capacity; new CRDMO molecule wins; API price/volume recovery.
